<?php
// Read input
list($n, $m) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
$total = $n * $m;

// Precompute neighbors for each cell
$neighbors = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        $id = $i * $m + $j;
        $neighbors[$id] = [];
        // stay
        $neighbors[$id][] = $id;
        // up
        if ($i > 0) $neighbors[$id][] = ($i - 1) * $m + $j;
        // down
        if ($i + 1 < $n) $neighbors[$id][] = ($i + 1) * $m + $j;
        // left
        if ($j > 0) $neighbors[$id][] = $i * $m + ($j - 1);
        // right
        if ($j + 1 < $m) $neighbors[$id][] = $i * $m + ($j + 1);
    }
}

// Precompute for each cell the bitmask of its neighbors
$neighborMasks = array_fill(0, $total, 0);
for ($i = 0; $i < $total; $i++) {
    $mask = 0;
    foreach ($neighbors[$i] as $v) {
        $mask |= (1 << $v);
    }
    $neighborMasks[$i] = $mask;
}

$best = 0;
$limit = 1 << $total;

// Enumerate all subsets S of cells that will be occupied after move
for ($mask = 0; $mask < $limit; $mask++) {
    // union of neighbor sets of S
    $union = 0;
    for ($i = 0; $i < $total; $i++) {
        if ($mask & (1 << $i)) {
            $union |= $neighborMasks[$i];
        }
    }
    // Check if every cell has at least one neighbor in S
    if ($union == $limit - 1) {
        $occupied = $total - substr_count(decbin($mask), '0'); // count bits set
        // faster bit count
        $cnt = 0;
        $tmp = $mask;
        while ($tmp) {
            $tmp &= ($tmp - 1);
            $cnt++;
        }
        $occupied = $cnt;
        $free = $total - $occupied;
        if ($free > $best) $best = $free;
    }
}

echo $best . PHP_EOL;
?>

                break;

                $canMove = true;
                break;
            }

            break;
        }

list($n, $m) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
$total = $n * $m;

// Precompute neighbors for each cell
// index: id = i*m + j
$neighbors = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        $id = $i * $m + $j;
        $list = [];
        // stay
        $list[] = $id;
        // up
        if ($i > 0) $list[] = ($i - 1) * $m + $j;
        // down
        if ($i + 1 < $n) $list[] = ($i + 1) * $m + $j;
        // left
        if ($j > 0) $list[] = $i * $m + ($j - 1);
        // right
        if ($j + 1 < $m) $list[] = $i * $m + ($j + 1);
        $neighbors[$id] = $list;
    }
}

$maxCovered = 0;

// Enumerate all possible assignments of destinations
// For each cell, choose one of its neighbors as destination
// We encode choices in mixed radix: base = degree of each cell
$deg = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $total; $i++) {
    $deg[$i] = count($neighbors[$i]);
}

// Precompute multipliers for mixed radix
$mult = array_fill(0, $total + 1, 1);
for ($i = 0; $i < $total; $i++) {
    $mult[$i + 1] = $mult[$i] * $deg[$i];
}
$allComb = $mult[$total];

for ($code = 0; $code < $allComb; $code++) {
    $tmp = $code;
    $coveredMask = 0;
    for ($cell = 0; $cell < $total; $cell++) {
        $choice = $tmp % $deg[$cell];
        $tmp = intdiv($tmp, $deg[$cell]);
        $dest = $neighbors[$cell][$choice];
        $coveredMask |= (1 << $dest);
    }
    // Count bits
    $covered = 0;
    $x = $coveredMask;
    while ($x) {
        $x &= ($x - 1);
        $covered++;
    }
    if ($covered > $maxCovered) $maxCovered = $covered;
}

echo ($total - $maxCovered) . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $m);
$N = $n * $m;

// Map cell (i,j) to index
function idx($i, $j, $m) {
    return $i * $m + $j;
}

// Precompute neighbors for each cell
$neighbors = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
    for ($j = 0; $j < $m; $j++) {
        $id = idx($i, $j, $m);
        $neighbors[$id] = [];
        // stay
        $neighbors[$id][] = $id;
        // up
        if ($i > 0) $neighbors[$id][] = idx($i - 1, $j, $m);
        // down
        if ($i + 1 < $n) $neighbors[$id][] = idx($i + 1, $j, $m);
        // left
        if ($j > 0) $neighbors[$id][] = idx($i, $j - 1, $m);
        // right
        if ($j + 1 < $m) $neighbors[$id][] = idx($i, $j + 1, $m);
    }
}

$maxFree = 0;

// Enumerate all assignments of moves: for each cell choose one neighbor
// Total combinations = product of degrees; but we brute force via mixed radix counting
$deg = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < $N; $i++) {
    $deg[$i] = count($neighbors[$i]);
}

$total = 1;
for ($i = 0; $i < $N; $i++) $total *= $deg[$i];

$choice = array_fill(0, $N, 0);

for ($iter = 0; $iter < $total; $iter++) {
    // compute occupied cells
    $occupiedMask = 0;
    for ($i = 0; $i < $N; $i++) {
        $to = $neighbors[$i][$choice[$i]];
        $occupiedMask |= (1 << $to);
    }
    // count free cells
    $free = 0;
    for ($i = 0; $i < $N; $i++) {
        if (!(($occupiedMask >> $i) & 1)) $free++;
    }
    if ($free > $maxFree) $maxFree = $free;

    // increment mixed-radix counter
    for ($pos = 0; $pos < $N; $pos++) {
        $choice[$pos]++;
        if ($choice[$pos] < $deg[$pos]) break;
        $choice[$pos] = 0;
    }
}

echo $maxFree . PHP_EOL;
?>

Write a program in PHP to solve this programming problem:
Description: Little Petya loves training spiders. Petya has a board n × m in size. Each cell of the board initially has a spider sitting on it. After one second Petya chooses a certain action for each spider, and all of them humbly perform its commands. There are 5 possible commands: to stay idle or to move from current cell to some of the four side-neighboring cells (that is, one command for each of the four possible directions). Petya gives the commands so that no spider leaves the field. It is allowed for spiders to pass through each other when they crawl towards each other in opposite directions. All spiders crawl simultaneously and several spiders may end up in one cell. Petya wants to know the maximum possible number of spider-free cells after one second.
Input Specification: The first line contains two space-separated integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 40, n·m ≤ 40) — the board sizes.
Output Specification: In the first line print the maximum number of cells without spiders.

Sample Input:
1 1
Sample Output:
0

Sample Input:
2 3
Sample Output:
4

Notes: NoteIn the first sample the only possible answer is:sIn the second sample one of the possible solutions is: rdlruls denotes command "stay idle", l, r, d, u denote commands "crawl left", "crawl right", "crawl down", "crawl up", correspondingly.
Take input from standard input and output to standard output
